The new `MortSubtableConverter` dispatches classic mort state tables to `StateHeader.read`. That reader uses `max(table.GlyphClassCount, 1)` to avoid division by zero, and with zero glyph classes its transition loop is empty, so the divisions in `_readTransition` are never reached. Thus a suitably formed zero-class state table can decompile and return successfully.
YES
